entries.question: Which architecture has demonstrated the strongest scaling of logical error suppression?
entries.note: Genesis holds no logical-qubit benchmark comparisons yet; this is Wave-2+ work.

entries.question: Which architectures have credible manufacturing paths — and credible means demonstrated in a real fab, not asserted?
entries.note: Partially bounded: silicon-spin and photonic-FBQC both show real-fab evidence; the rest of the field is unmapped at this resolution.

entries.question: What is the best architecture-neutral definition of economically useful quantum computation?
entries.note: DARPA's working definition — computational value exceeds cost — is the current anchor; alternatives need registration.

entries.question: How much classical compute does fault-tolerant decoding require at utility scale?
entries.note: Registered as a cross-architecture bottleneck with no bound yet.

entries.question: Which architectures face physical scaling problems versus primarily engineering scaling problems?
entries.note: Photonics reads as physics-bound on loss; silicon-spin reads as engineering-bound on uniformity — the distinction drives which evidence to demand next.

entries.question: Which quantum supply-chain capabilities are shared across architectures?
entries.note: Dilution refrigeration and isotopically enriched silicon are already visibly shared; full fan-out needs the Wave-2 company pass.

entries.question: How predictive has government technical selection historically been?
entries.note: The QBI forecast entry begins the measurement; no resolution history exists yet.

entries.question: How predictive are customer procurements of eventual utility?
entries.note: Two procurement/award events are in the ledger with explicit non-validation labels; resolution needs the follow-through record.

entries.question: How often have major quantum roadmaps slipped, and by how much?
entries.note: One slipped-then-delivered milestone and one past-due open milestone are seeded; the baseline rate is unmeasured.

entries.question: Which companies systematically over- or under-promise?
entries.note: Requires resolved-forecast history per company — deliberately not estimable yet.

entries.question: What evidence would falsify silicon-spin manufacturability as a durable advantage?
entries.note: Falsifiers registered on the architecture record; watching for device-variability results at wafer scale.

entries.question: When does quantum integrate into HPC rather than remain an isolated accelerator?
entries.note: EuroQCS procurement is the leading observable; no integration benchmark exists in the ledger.
